parameters.help_en: The pagination token that marks the position from which to start reading. If this parameter is left empty, data is read from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of data records to read in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of the threat analysis feature is located. Specify the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the automated response rule
parameters.name: response_rule_id

parameters.example: Send Notification When Generating Urgent Incident
parameters.help_en: The name of the automated response rule
parameters.name: response_rule_name

parameters.help_en: The execution priority of the automated response rule
parameters.help_zh: 自动化响应规则执行优先级
parameters.name: response_rule_priority

parameters.help_en: The trigger condition configuration of the rule
parameters.name: response_execution_condition

parameters.help_en:
The action type of the automated response rule. Valid values:

doPlaybook: execute a playbook.
changeEventStatus: update the event status.
changeThreatLevel: update the event threat level.
addEventTag: add an event label.
deleteEventTag: delete an event label.
alertWhitelist: add the alert to the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应规则动作类型。

doPlaybook：执行剧本
changeEventStatus：更新事件状态
changeThreatLevel：更新事件威胁等级
addEventTag：添加事件标签
deleteEventTag：删除事件标签
alertWhitelist：告警加白
parameters.name: response_action_type

parameters.help_en:
The trigger type of the automated response rule. Valid values:

event: event occurred.
event_update: event updated.
alert: alert occurred
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应规则触发类型。

event：事件发生
event_update：事件更新
alert：告警发生
parameters.name: response_trigger_type

parameters.help_en: The action configuration of the automated response rule
parameters.help_zh: 自动化响应规则执行动作配置
parameters.name: response_action_config

parameters.help_en:
The status of the automated response rule. Valid values:

0: disabled.
100: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应规则状态。

0：未开启
100：已开启
parameters.name: response_rule_status
